members.doc: Parent class for all browsers. Do not use directly.

members.name: Chrome
members.doc: Launcher class for Google Chrome browser.

members.name: Chromium
members.doc: Launcher class for Google Chrome browser.

members.name: Edge
members.doc: Launcher class for Microsoft Edge browser.

members.name: Error
members.doc: Common base class for all non-exit exceptions.

members.name: GenericBrowser
members.doc: Class for all browsers started with a command and without remote functionality.

members.name: get
members.doc: Return a browser launcher instance appropriate for the environment.

members.name: Konqueror
members.doc: Controller for the KDE File Manager (kfm, or Konqueror). See the output of ``kfmclient --commands`` for more information on the Konqueror remote-control interfa

members.name: open
members.doc: Display url using the default browser. If possible, open url in a location determined by new. - 0: the same browser window (the default). - 1: a new browser win

members.name: open_new
members.doc: Open url in a new window of the default browser. If not possible, then open url in the only browser window.

members.name: open_new_tab
members.doc: Open url in a new page ("tab") of the default browser. If not possible, then the behavior becomes equivalent to open_new().

members.name: UnixBrowser
members.doc: Parent class for all Unix browsers with remote functionality.

members.name: WindowsDefault
members.doc: Parent class for all browsers. Do not use directly.
